summary: Green Circle Decarbonize Technology Limited (NYSE American: GCDT), a Cayman Islands holding company operating via Hong Kong-based Boca International Limited, furnished a 6-K announcing a 1-for-6 share consolidation of its ordinary shares, including Class A ordinary shares, effective 12:01 a.m. ET on October 7, 2026. The board approved and shareholders ratified the action at an August 10, 2026 EGM. Par value rises from US$0.001 to US$0.006; trading continues under GCDT with new CUSIP G4092C131; fractional entitlements round up; Odyssey Trust Company serves as exchange agent. This is a routine capital-structure change, not a special situation; watch for reverse-split-driven price volatility and any subsequent NYSE American listing-compliance or capital-raising activity.
